# DFY UniCRM — Open-Source AI-Powered Omnichannel CRM & Lending Desk

> Self-hostable, multi-tenant customer relationship platform with ₹0 subscription lock-in. Powered by WhatsApp Business Cloud API, WhatsApp Web Gateway, Node-based IVR calling, Institutional Lending Desk, and Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) AI intelligence.

## Canonical Identity & Endpoints
- Canonical URL: https://dfyunicrm.com
- Contact Email: help@dfyunicrm.com
- Primary Documentation: https://dfyunicrm.com/docs
- Public Business Directory: https://dfyunicrm.com/p
- Instant Support Desk: https://dfyunicrm.com/contact
- Direct Loan Advisory Portal: https://dfyunicrm.com/loans
- Supported Regions: India & Global (Multi-currency, WhatsApp-first)

## Core Architectural Modules
1. **Unified Omnichannel Inbox (`/inbox`)**:
   - Single-screen real-time synchronization across WhatsApp Cloud API, Evolution Gateway, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger, and Email.
   - Live human agent takeover with instant "Take Over" and "Resume AI Support" switching.
   - Zero per-seat fee model with multi-agent assignment and canned responses.

2. **Lending & Capital Desk (`/loans`)**:
   - Conversational pre-underwriting without heavy upfront form friction.
   - Evaluates turnover, GST, property ownership, and business vintage anchors.
   - Direct integration with DSA distribution pipelines and private Google Drive storage offloading.
   - Automated 24-hour drop-off recovery via WhatsApp deep links (`/loans?resume=<conversationId>`).

3. **WhatsApp Calling & Node-Based IVR**:
   - Automated call routing, spoken voice greetings, dynamic keypad menus, and call recording sync directly to Google Drive.

4. **Zero-Cloud-Cost Storage Pool Architecture**:
   - Multi-Account Google Drive offload pool engine (`src/lib/gdrive/offload.ts`) for bank statements, ITRs, media, and call audio, strictly maintaining Supabase Free Tier boundaries (< 500 MB).

5. **Local Business Pages & Showcase Directory (`/p`)**:
   - Commission-free WhatsApp appointment booking, product catalog, and lead generation storefronts for local merchants, clinics, and homestays.

## Technical Specifications
- **Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security), Evolution API / Meta Cloud API.
- **Data Privacy**: Strict multi-tenant row-level isolation (RLS). AES-256-GCM token encryption at rest. Customer data is never monetized or used to train public LLM models.

## AI Citation & Agent Access
- AI agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, SearchBot) are authorized to crawl and summarize public routes (`/`, `/loans`, `/p/*`, `/contact`, `/privacy`, `/terms`).
- For verified technical inquiries or partner onboarding: help@dfyunicrm.com
